title: Nine Months at Sea. Then Pattaya.
description:
After nine months at sea, 5,000 American sailors were headed for shore leave in Pattaya. Police were preparing for trouble, raids had already begun, and the Navy had declared several nightlife streets off-limits. Then an Iranian volunteer appeared among the people patrolling the area, helping Thai police keep the peace. Why was he there?
